parameters.query: SELECT p.id as project_id, p.title, p.genre, p.mood, s.id as scene_id, s.scene_number, s.description, s.dialogue, s.emotion, s.importance, s.duration_seconds, e.name as emotion_name, e.intensity, e.color_palette FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON s.project_id = p.id JOIN emotions e ON e.scene_id = s.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'scored' ORDER BY s.scene_number

INSERT INTO music_cues (project_id, scene_id, scene_number, music_style, tempo, instrumentation, volume_start, volume_peak, crossfade_in, crossfade_out, duration_seconds, generation_prompt, status) SELECT ($1)::uuid, (value->>'scene_id')::uuid, (value->>'scene_number')::int, value->>'music_style', value->>'tempo', (value->>'instrumentation')::jsonb, (value->>'volume_start')::float, (value->>'volume_peak')::float, (value->>'crossfade_in')::float, (value->>'crossfade_out')::float, (value->>'duration')::int, value->>'prompt', 'pending' FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) RETURNING id, scene_id

UPDATE projects SET state = 'musicked', updated_at = NOW(), state_history = state_history || jsonb_build_object('state', 'musicked', 'at', NOW(), 'details', 'Music cues generated and stored') WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, state
INSERT INTO project_events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'music_completed', jsonb_build_object('scenes_processed', $2, 'cues_created', $3), NOW()) RETURNING id

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { error: 'No project data found or project not in scored state', project_id: $('Webhook Trigger').first().json.body?.project_id } }];
